source.title: Ttp Attacks and Locations of Deportations of Afghan Refugees in Pakistan Between August and October 2023

map.title_on_map: TTP Attacks and Locations of Deportations of Afghan Refugees in Pakistan
map.subtitle: Between August and October 2023
map.producer: Critical Threats Project at the American Enterprise Institute
map.caption_text: Deportation authorities are at risk of attacks by the TTP, which would help build TTP support zones. The TTP condemned the deportations and called for attacks in response. The area where Pakistan is expelling refugees is located near TTP attack zones.
